**Job Title:** DEVELOPER L4
  
**City:** Hyderabad
  
**State/Province:** Telangana
  
**Posting Start Date:** 8/2/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
  
  

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏
  
  

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** Informatica iPaas .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .
  
  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer who can own features end\-to\-end—from understanding business requirements and designing scalable solutions to development, deployment, and production support. jobs.title: Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
**About Techdome**
------------------


Techdome is a product\-driven technology company building AI\-first solutions across Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, Payments, and Enterprise SaaS. We believe Product Owners should do more than manage backlogs they should own customer outcomes, drive product strategy, and bridge the gap between business and technology to build products that create real impact.**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a **Technical Product Owner** with a strong engineering mindset and experience managing customer\-facing B2C products. In this role, you'll own the product lifecycle end\-to\-end from product discovery and roadmap planning to execution, launch, and continuous improvement. You'll work closely with Founders, Engineering, Design, QA, and Business teams to deliver scalable, AI\-powered products that solve real customer problems.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Ownership**

* Own product features from ideation through development, launch, and continuous enhancement.
* Define product vision, roadmap, feature prioritization, and release plans aligned with business goals.
* Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer, business, and technical requirements.

### **Product Planning \& Documentation**

* Create and maintain PRDs, BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Epics, Acceptance Criteria, Process Flows, and Product Backlogs.
* Translate business requirements into clear, actionable engineering deliverables.
* Ensure product documentation remains accurate and up to date throughout the development lifecycle.

### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Engineering teams on APIs, integrations, solution design, technical feasibility, and architecture discussions.
* Partner with UX/UI teams to deliver intuitive and customer\-centric user experiences.
* Collaborate with QA, Operations, and Business teams to ensure successful product releases.

### **Agile Delivery**

* Lead Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, UAT, and Release Planning.
* Monitor delivery timelines, remove blockers, and ensure high\-quality product releases.
* Drive continuous product improvements based on customer feedback and product analytics.

**AI\-First Product Management**
--------------------------------


At Techdome, AI is an integral part of product development and decision\-making.
We're looking for Product Owners who actively leverage AI to improve research, documentation, planning, and productivity.
Hands\-on experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Perplexity, Notion AI, or similar AI platforms is highly preferred.
Experience using AI for:* Product research and competitive analysis
* Requirement gathering and documentation
* PRDs, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria
* Roadmap planning and feature prioritization
* Meeting summaries and stakeholder communication
* Workflow automation and productivity enhancement

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* 3\+ years of experience as a Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or Technical Business Analyst.
* Experience owning B2C digital products from ideation to production.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, SDLC, Product Lifecycle Management, Sprint Planning, Backlog Management, and Release Management.
* Hands\-on experience creating product documentation, including PRDs, BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Epics, and Acceptance Criteria.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and modern collaboration tools.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, SQL, Databases, System Integrations, Cloud Fundamentals, and Technical Architecture.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and decision\-making skills.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Customer\-first mindset with a passion for solving real business problems.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive products independently.
* Data\-driven decision\-making using customer insights, analytics, and market research.
* Excellent collaboration skills across Engineering, Design, Business, and Leadership teams.
* Continuous learner with an interest in AI, emerging technologies, and product innovation.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with AI\-powered products or SaaS platforms.
* Exposure to Product Analytics tools such as Mixpanel, GA4, or Amplitude.
* Knowledge of Payments, Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, or Enterprise SaaS domains.
* Product strategy, go\-to\-market planning, and customer journey mapping.

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* AI Interview (JustInterview.ai)
* Technical \& Functional Discussion
* Leadership Discussion.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Are you interested in working for one of the most exciting teams at Microsoft owning a fundamental piece of the Azure cloud? Looking for a new challenge to demonstrate your expertise in building systems at massive scale with extremely high availability (100% SLA)? Then look no further than the Azure DNS Team. We are looking for an engineer with deep technical expertise, a curiosity\-driven mindset, and a strong sense of ownership. You’ll work on globally distributed, scalable, and low\-latency services that serve critical workloads across the globe.  

  

The Azure DNS team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer with deep technical expertise, a curiosity\-driven mindset, and a strong sense of ownership. You will work to design and implement a globally distributed, scalable and low latency super service that provides DNS capabilities for the most critical domains in the world. The developer will work with a team of other software engineers to design and implement various components that constitute this state\-of\-the\-art distributed systems solution and ensure a timely execution of the components with high quality \- think of 1 billion records at very low latencies. Running DNS at such scale requires building systems that are resilient to multiple failure patterns with continuous investments in quality of service.  

  

 Azure DNS also enables other innovations in Azure by providing a robust platform for resource naming across all Azure features like Storage, Software Defined Networking, databases and Azure Compute. This provides an enormous learning opportunity to build integrated solutions with other Azure services. This team also owns building services for DDoS protection of DNS service and you will play a key role in ensuring a smooth integration of core DNS services with the DDoS solutions. In our work environment, you will find very friendly co\-workers eager to welcome you to the team and help you along the way. We foster and reward collaboration as a key part of our culture and we look forward to meeting you!

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

We are seeking a senior, technically strong Business Analyst to support our Claravine product team in a fully Agile environment. This role will serve as the primary BA and a close partner to the Product Owner, combining business analysis, Claravine administration, technical documentation, and product delivery support.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with the Product Owner on product discovery, prioritization, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release delivery.
* Elicit, analyze, and document business and technical requirements; create epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data mappings, and decision records.
* Administer and support Claravine capabilities related to metadata, taxonomies, naming conventions, templates, fields, lists, validation rules, datasets, permissions, and workflows.
* Understand the end\-to\-end architecture, including Claravine integrations, APIs, upstream and downstream systems, and data flows; translate effectively between business and technical teams.
* Ensure each initiative has clear business value, an accountable business owner, agreed scope and priority, measurable success criteria, and stakeholder approval.
* Maintain strong Jira hygiene, including ticket quality, ownership, status, dependencies, risks, sprint and release data, and end\-to\-end traceability.
* Maintain current functional, technical, and operational documentation in Confluence; coordinate UAT, business sign\-off, release readiness, and stakeholder communications.


**Required Experience**
* Mandatory : Proven, hands\-on production experience with the Claravine or similar platforms; general metadata experience or platform familiarity alone is not sufficient.
* Strong or proven expertise or experience in metadata management, taxonomy design, data standards, naming conventions, validation rules, and data governance.
* Senior\-level Business Analyst experience within Agile product teams, with advanced working knowledge of Jira and Confluence.
* Strong technical background in system architecture, APIs, integrations, data models, data mapping, and end\-to\-end data flows.
* Strong product and business\-value mindset, with the ability to challenge unclear requests and secure alignment with business partners.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, documentation, organization, and attention to detail.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
 Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) is a US\-based financial technology company that builds and maintains sophisticated option pricing and risk management software used daily by commodity traders, brokers, and risk managers. This position is based in Hyderabad, India, as part of an established team of QA professionals supporting ICE's global platform, and reports to a local QA Manager in Hyderabad.
   

  

 As a QA Analyst, you will be embedded across the full software development lifecycle, with ownership of test strategy spanning client\- and server\-side components, APIs, and system integrations. You will collaborate closely with quantitative analysts, developers, and product owners in a fast\-paced environment in which software quality carries real\-world consequences. Job Title Support Analyst IT – Quality
   

  

 Location  Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Job Summary  We are seeking a skilled Support Analyst in Quality Portfolio to provide reliable application support and operational excellence for key Quality IT systems.
   

  

 This role focuses on supporting and maintaining specialized applications critical to quality management, laboratory operations, regulatory compliance, and sustainability initiatives across supply chain and manufacturing processes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings strong technical support expertise, hands\-on knowledge of LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System), Polarion (Application Lifecycle Management / Quality Assurance platform), and Sustainability applications (e.g., ESG tracking, waste/carbon management tools, or environmental compliance systems), to ensure system availability, user satisfaction, data integrity, and minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 The position requires proactive issue resolution, user training, and collaboration with business stakeholders and IT teams—without involvement in software development, testing, or engineering tasks. Reporting to the Quality IT Delivery Lead and collaborating with onshore portfolio leadership, the analyst will contribute to stable, compliant, and efficient Quality IT operations.
   

  

 This role should be working 4 days a week onshore from Hyderabad MTIC office and provides support on shift basis to covers 24x7 support for critical Quality applications.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide first and second\-level support for LIMS, Polarion, and Sustainability applications troubleshoot incidents, resolve user queries, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement fixes or workarounds in a timely manner.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Data Quality \& AI Readiness Product Analyst


Job Location: Hyderabad Hub


Job Type: Fulltime/Permanent

***About the Job***


As a Data Quality \& AI Readiness Product Analyst within the MDM Jobs/Skills Taxonomy team — part of Data Governance \& Master Data Management — you will sit at the intersection of data governance, Human Capital technology, and process excellence. You will be a critical enabler of Sanofi's enterprise\-wide skills\-based organization initiative, ensuring that the skills and jobs data powering Workday's Skills Cloud, Career Hub, and AI\-driven talent matching is trusted, complete, and AI\-ready.


You will drive proactive risk management, resolve global data quality issues, and ensure our Human Capital data meets Sanofi's AI\-Ready Data Framework standards — making it fit to power both operational decisions and the AI\-driven innovation that underpins our mission to chase the miracles of science.

**Main responsibilities**

*1\. Investigation \& Diagnosis*

* Assess and document downstream impact of Skills and Job Architecture data quality issues across payroll processing, management reporting, third\-party integrations, and AI/machine learning model inputs
* Monitor ongoing adoption of global data standards across regions, business units, and functional teams, with particular focus on Skills and Job Architecture taxonomy data consistency in Workday — proactively detecting and flagging the re\-introduction of local deviations, non\-standard values, or workarounds
* Conduct structured root cause analyses to distinguish isolated errors from systemic issues requiring process or configuration\-level intervention
* Use Python scripting and SQL to conduct deep\-dive data profiling and root cause investigations across Workday and Snowflake data assets
* Build reusable investigation toolkits and diagnostic scripts to accelerate root cause analysis and reduce time\-to\-resolution across recurring issue patterns
* Support organizational cloning and data standardization initiatives through fact\-based investigation, evidence gathering, and data profiling — ensuring skills data is structured and clean for AI model consumption
* Execute Data Analysis and Mapping for Workday Optimization and other relevant projects

*2\. Data Quality Engineering \& Automation*

* Design and build automated Skills and Job Architecture data quality pipelines using Python to validate, profile, and monitor at scale, integrated into the Data Foundation (Snowflake)
* Contribute to the design and implementation of data observability practices — including data lineage tracking, freshness monitoring, and schema validation — across the Skills and Job Architecture data domains
* Build automated monitoring dashboards (e.g., Power BI) and alerting mechanisms to proactively surface data quality deviations before they impact downstream systems, enabling early resolution of cloning/standardization conflicts

*3\. Data Remediation \& Execution*

* Develop and execute Python\-based remediation scripts and automated correction workflows reducing reliance on manual EIB loads where technically feasible and accelerating remediation
* Prepare, validate, and execute data correction actions and remediation loads (EIB, manual)
* Partner closely with the Global Process Owner (GPO) and Workday Technology teams to define and implement structural fixes — whether through process redesign, system configuration changes, or governance policy updates — and deliver measurable improvement in priority data quality fields

*4\. Governance, Risk \& Stakeholder Collaboration*

* Serve as a bridge between data operations and technical teams, translating business data quality requirements into actionable technical specifications aligned with MDM standards
* Identify and escalate risks to data consistency, AI readiness, and global reporting accuracy at the earliest possible stage
* Contribute to AI\-Ready Data KPI scoring for the relevant data assets, including DQ rule coverage, quality scoring in Informatica CDGC, metadata cataloging, and data access classification

***About You***

 *Required Education, Experience \& Skills*

* Degree in Information Systems, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Data Management, or a related field
* 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, data quality, data governance, or a related analytical/technical role
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building data pipelines, validation frameworks, or automation scripts in Python
* Proven track record of conducting data investigations and delivering structured, actionable findings
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization with cross\-functional stakeholders
* Strong SQL skills for data profiling, investigation, and validation across large\-scale HR datasets
* Experience with big data technologies such as Snowflake
* Experience building and maintaining ELT/ETL pipelines for data quality monitoring and remediation
* Familiarity with data remediation processes, including mass data loads and EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder) or equivalent
* Understanding of HR data domains: employee records, organizational structures, skills profiles, compensation, payroll inputs, and workforce reporting
* Experience with data quality platforms or monitoring tools (e.g., Informatica CDGC, Collibra, Ataccama, or similar)

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry
* Experience working with Workday HCM or comparable enterprise HR platforms is a strong plus — Workday certification or formal training valued but not required as the primary technical requirement
* Familiarity with Workday Skills Cloud, Career Hub and their underlying data structures
* Exposure to MLOps or AI/ML data pipeline engineering
* Certification in data governance, data quality management, or HR analytics
* Knowledge of GDPR, data privacy regulations, and their implications for HR data management

Job Description:
**Job Purpose**


Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) is a US\-based financial technology company that builds and maintains sophisticated option pricing and risk management software used daily by commodity traders, brokers, and risk managers. This position is based in Hyderabad, India, as part of an established team of QA professionals supporting ICE's global platform, and reports to a local QA Manager in Hyderabad.

  

As a QA Analyst, you will be embedded across the full software development lifecycle, with ownership of test strategy spanning client\- and server\-side components, APIs, and system integrations. You will collaborate closely with quantitative analysts, developers, and product owners in a fast\-paced environment in which software quality carries real\-world consequences. The role is well suited to a candidate who demonstrates strong ownership, applies critical thinking to complex financial systems, and brings both analytical rigor and sound testing judgment to every release.

 **Responsibilities**

* Plan, design, document, and execute comprehensive test plans for new and existing features based on business and functional requirements.
* Report and manage defects and test activities throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Apply options and risk management domain knowledge to design and execute analytically meaningful test cases.
* Review and analyze client\- and server\-side log files during testing to validate expected system behavior, confirm test coverage, and provide evidence that functionality performs as designed.
* Own QA activities throughout software releases, including post\-release troubleshooting and Level 2 support.
* Partner with development, quantitative analysis, and customer support teams to reproduce, diagnose, and resolve issues.
* Leverage AI tools to accelerate test case generation, defect triage, documentation, and data analysis.

* 5\+ years of QA experience.
* Clear, professional communication and strong attention to detail across test documentation, defect reports, and cross\-team correspondence.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.
* Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, concise reports, tickets, and testing documentation.

* Strong SQL skills, with the ability to independently write queries to inspect and validate data.

 **Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* The opportunity to work on high\-impact financial technology used by professional traders and risk managers.
* A collaborative environment alongside experienced quantitative analysts, developers, and product owners.
* The opportunity to deepen your expertise in options theory, derivatives markets, and financial analytics.

jobs.description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  

  

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  

  

**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

The Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, and release of our organization's web and mobile applications.  

  

**What you will do**


* Working closely with Product owners and other stakeholders to understand the requirements and design software solutions to meet the product requirements
* Develops applications focusing on presentation layer using Application programming interfaces (APIs) and Micro Services architecture
* Develops unit and automation test scripts under the test driven development lifecycle
* Contributes to the coding best practices and help with code merges and releases.
* Performs other duties as assigned
* Complies with all policies and standards


**Education Qualifications**


* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience required


**Experience Qualifications**


* Typically 2\+ years 2\+ years of hands\-on object\-oriented programming in Java or Python and/or Javascript (UI) (Angular or ReactJS) frameworks required


**Skills and Abilities**


* Understanding of all phases of Software development life cycle
* Software Development Experience with Java or Python
* Experience with UI modern framework like AngularJS or ReactJS
* Experience with microservice architecture, end\-to\-end UI/API integration, and knowledge of API protocols like REST, gRPC, and graphQL
* Familiar with coding and testing best practices as well as ability to understand complex business problems and design high quality technical solutions.
* Knowledge about the Caching technologies and DBMS technologies like Oracle or MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB
* Strong Problem\-solving, communication and organizational skills


**Travel Requirements**  

Minimal  

  

**Work Environment**


* Work in a clean, pleasant, and comfortable office work setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* This position is 100% in office.


Please Note: TriNet reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Position functions and qualifications may vary depending on business necessity.  

  

TriNet is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), age, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. Any applicant with a mental or physical disability who requires an accommodation during the application process should contact India\_Recruitment@Trinet.com to request such an accommodation.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
****Product Manager, B2B Platform****
****Reports to:****
 Product Lead, B2B Platform (Singapore)
   

  

****Type:****
 Permanent, Full\-Time
   

  

****The Opportunity: Build the platform behind the advice****
 In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We are not building another trading app. We are building the financial infrastructure that helps people reach their most important life goals: retirement, education, and financial freedom.
   

  

 Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia, and the first digital advisor to span both private wealth and public pension savings (CPF and SRS in Singapore). Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 billion for more than a quarter\-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global names (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region.
   

  

 Beyond serving clients directly, we power financial advisers. Our B2B platform gives advisory firms and their advisers institutional\-grade funds, portfolio construction and discretionary management tools, digital onboarding, and the commercials to grow their business. This role owns the delivery and day\-to\-day health of that platform. Over time it will extend to new B2B initiatives, such as Hong Kong's pension market (MPF and ORSO), but the immediate focus is our financial adviser business.
   

  

****Become the first PM of India Hub****
 Our India team is a core engineering hub, not a support office. This role is the first product manager we are hiring here, sitting alongside our engineers and reporting into the Product Lead in Singapore.
   

  

 You will own scoped platform work for the B2B advisor platform end to end, from spec to shipped, partnering daily with the India engineers and closely with the Singapore product team, who drive the wider roadmap. You will have genuine ownership of how the work gets solved and whether it lands, and because you sit closest to the platform, your insight will help shape what we prioritise next.
   

  

 If you want to be the person who establishes how product delivery works on the ground in India, with direct visibility to leadership and room to grow your scope by shipping, this is a rare seat.
   

  

****The Role: Keep it running, make it better****
 Our advisers and their clients trust the platform with real money every day. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "move fast and prove it's safe."
   

  

 This is a hands\-on delivery role. You will own the health of our financial adviser platform: keeping it stable, closing gaps, and shipping the enhancements advisers ask for. Most companies treat an execution PM as a backlog administrator. We do not. You will be trusted to derive the right fix or feature from a messy problem, not wait for someone to hand you a plan.
   

  

****Here's what you can look forward to in this role:****
****Own the platform advisers live in:****
 You will drive delivery across the core adviser journeys: fund and portfolio construction, digital onboarding and unit transfers, recurring investment schedules, fee setup, and order fulfilment and reconciliation.
   

  

****Keep it stable and safe:****
 You will own the day\-to\-day health of the platform, triaging issues, tightening flows, and making sure nothing breaks the trust advisers place in it.
   

  

****Turn ambiguity into specs:****
 You will engage operations, compliance, client experience, and data to understand adviser and partner needs, and synthesise them into clear specifications and prioritised backlogs.
   

  

****Manage the squad, not just the backlog:****
 You will lead a cross\-functional squad of engineers and designers through delivery, preparing technical specifications, coordinating build, and keeping in\-flight work on track.
   

  

****Work with partners and firms:****
 You will interface with our distribution partner and FA firms to clarify requirements, unblock integrations, and turn their needs into shipped features.
   

  

****Prove it worked:****
 You will work with data analysts to find the real pain points and validate that what you shipped actually met its goal.
   

  

****Operate across borders:****
 You will coordinate with Singapore and Hong Kong teams across timezones, where short feedback loops are the norm.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
* First 30 Days (Immersion): You understand the financial adviser platform, how advisers and firms use it day to day, and our delivery model. You have shipped your first well\-scoped fix or enhancement.
* First 90 Days (Ownership): You own the platform backlog for the squad, are writing specifications that engineering can build from without hand\-holding, and have shipped several adviser\-facing improvements.
* First 6 Months (Impact): You own delivery and maintenance of the platform end\-to\-end. FA firms and the Singapore product team treat you as the source of truth for it, and you are ready to take on new initiatives, including future ORSO and MPF work in Hong Kong, as they come.


**What You Bring (Requirements)**
 We care more about your judgement and ownership than your familiarity with any particular tool. This role requires a specific baseline.
   

  

****Must\-Haves:****
* 4 to 6 years of product management, ideally shipping within a cross\-functional squad model.
* Strong execution discipline: you write clear specifications, coordinate engineering and design, and ship quality features on a predictable cadence.
* Regulated\-domain instinct: you can operate where compliance detail is not optional, and you treat it as a design constraint rather than an afterthought.
* A clear communicator and team player who navigates ambiguity and drives well\-scoped problems independently.


****Nice\-to\-Haves:****
* Exposure to FinTech, WealthTech, or another regulated indus…

jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
   

  

 The Product Owner partners closely with
 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams** 
 to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
 **clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact** 
 in a complex, enterprise data environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership \& Accountability**
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**
* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.


**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.


**Governance, Quality \& Standards**
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.


**Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Product Owner is a
 **critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model** 
 , ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

jobs.title: Planning & Reporting CoE Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.



Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

**About the Finance Planning \& Reporting CoE**
-----------------------------------------------



Driving efficiency and standardization across our renowned consumer brands that enhance everyday lives—from nourishing meals to trusted household essentials—is the pivotal force of the Finance Planning \& Reporting Center of Excellence (CoE). Fuelled by a culture of collaboration and innovation, the CoE is integral to our organization, championing financial excellence and strategic insight across our global landscape. We are a dynamic, agile team, relentlessly focused on enhancing our financial processes, harnessing advanced analytics, and delivering unparalleled value to every facet of our business.



We transcend traditional finance roles; we are a strategic partner where diverse talents converge to tackle intricate financial challenges, foster sustainable growth, and empower our mission to create a healthier, more sustainable world for all. By ensuring a clear line of sight between strategic goals and day\-to\-day financial activities, we enable efficient performance management and better business results through the collaboration of our people, processes, and systems.



Our CoE transforms finance from a traditional back\-office function into a strategic powerhouse that drives business value, as talented individuals come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better business.

**About the role**
------------------



As an Analyst in the Finance CoE, you will report into a Finance Manager and be part of a team of analysts supporting a portfolio of markets. In this role, you will play a key part in executing financial planning and reporting activities across these markets. You will support the creation of standardized reports, development of initial forecasts/budgets, and analysis of financial performance to enable data\-driven decision\-making.



This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to multiple markets while contributing to the centralization and improvement of Reckitt’s FP\&A processes. If you are passionate about finance, data analysis, and continuous improvement, this role will allow you to grow and make a real impact on our global business.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


* Produce and consolidate financial reports for monthly and quarterly results, ensuring key performance metrics (sales, profitability, costs, etc.) are accurately reported and delivered on time to global and regional stakeholders.
* Conduct variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) and clearly explain drivers behind the numbers, highlighting trends and insights that inform business decisions.
* Support the planning and forecasting cycles, including annual budgets and periodic forecasts: coordinate data collection from different markets, validate submissions, and align assumptions with global guidelines to create a cohesive financial outlook.
* Manage and enhance financial dashboards and reports (e.g. in Power BI or similar tools) to provide users with intuitive, up\-to\-date views of financial performance. Ensure that dashboards capture the right KPIs and that data is consistent across all reporting outputs.
* Participate in finance transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline and improve existing FP\&A processes. You’ll contribute to standardizing report templates, automating manual tasks, and sharing best practices that elevate our CoE’s efficiency and impact.
* Collaborate closely with market finance teams and other CoE members to ensure data integrity and one\-source\-of\-truth in our financial systems. You will act as a liaison, helping local teams understand CoE processes and troubleshooting data or reporting issues to maintain accuracy.
* Assist with ad\-hoc analysis and projects as needed, such as deep\-dives into specific expenses or trends, scenario modeling for strategic projects, or financial deck preparation for senior leadership meetings. Your ability to turn data into actionable insights will be key in these projects.
* Adapt and excel in a dynamic environment – our CoE is continually evolving. You’ll be expected to handle last\-minute changes or requests, work under tight deadlines especially during key reporting periods, and maintain a high standard of quality. In doing so, you’ll demonstrate agility, teamwork, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* 3\-4 years of experience in finance, analytics, or a related field, ideally within the CPG sector.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with reporting tools (e.g., Power BI).
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
**The skills for success**
--------------------------


* Financial Analysis \& Reporting
* Strategic Planning
* Business Partnering
* Process Improvement
* Data Visualization Skills
* Project Management
* Team Leadership
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Change Management
* Continuous Improvement Mindset
**What we offer**
-----------------


With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees glo…

jobs.title: Agentic Business Process Analyst
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Role overview**

  

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an Agentic Business Process Analyst to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current\-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

  

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process\-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent\-enabled processes.

  

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

 **What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end\-to\-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first\-time\-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value\-led, AI\-enabled transformation work.

 **What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

 **Required experience**

* 6 or more years of experience as a business analyst, functional consultant, process consultant, product owner, transformation consultant, or similar role.
* Strong experience mapping, analyzing, and redesigning business processes.
* Experience working on enterprise technology implementations, preferably involving Microsoft Dynamics 365, CRM, ERP, Power Platform, data platforms, workflow automation, or related business applications.
* Ability to facilitate workshops with business users, technical teams, and senior stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of process metrics, business value measurement, operational KPIs, and adoption measures.
* Ability to write clear functional requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, solution narratives, and executive\-ready recommendations.
* Comfort working with technical teams on AI, automation, data, integration, and system design topics.
* Ability to mentor other consultants and help teams adopt new ways of working.

 **Preferred experience**

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
* Experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, process mining, business process catalogs, customer journey mapping, service design, or operating model transformation.
* Experience identifying AI use cases, automation candidates, decision support opportunities, or agentic process patterns.
* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Exposure to responsible AI, governance, risk, compliance, controls, or regulated industry environments.

 **Mindset we need**


This person should not be a note\-taker or requirements scribe. They should be a transformation\-oriented business analyst who can challenge assumptions, ask better questions, and guide clients toward the right solution.

  

They should be able to say,…

Brigade Hospitality Services Limited (BHSL) is a fully\-owned subsidiary of Brigade Enterprises Limited. **Skills \& Competencies**

* Creative thinker with the ability to translate market opportunities into profitable business.

**About Impact Analytics**
 Impact Analytics is an agentic\-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made. What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.
   

  

 For candidates looking to work on next\-generation AI products with global scale and real\-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here’s a link to our website: www.impactanalytics.co.
   

  

**The impact that you will be making**
 We are seeking a delivery\-focused
 **Technical Product Manager** 
 to bridge the gap between our engineering teams and core business stakeholders. In this role, you will hold end\-to\-end ownership of the product delivery lifecycle, acting as the critical interface for
 **onsite stakeholders** 
 .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Stakeholder Management \& Product Strategy
* Onsite Stakeholder Interface: Serve as the primary, trusted point of contact for onsite teams, business leaders, and product counterparts across international regions.
* Requirement Clarity: Run workshops to capture business requirements, translate them into comprehensive technical specifications, and manage feature prioritization trade\-offs.
* Expectation Alignment: Effectively communicate project roadmaps, risks, mitigation strategies, and milestone metrics to senior leadership.
* Program \& Cross\-Team Coordination
* Break down Product's requirements/roadmap into technical execution plans across multiple engineering teams
* Identify dependencies between teams, systems, and workstreams
* Drive alignment across engineering, product, design, and other stakeholders
* Technical Backlog \& Execution Management
* Work with engineering leads to structure the technical backlog (sequencing and execution, not defining what to build)
* Break down epics into technical tasks/tickets in collaboration with tech leads
* Prioritize technical debt, infrastructure work, and dependencies alongside feature work
* Scrum Master / Agile Facilitation
* Run sprint ceremonies (standups, planning, retros, backlog grooming)
* Remove blockers for engineering pods
* Track sprint velocity, burndown, and team capacity
* Coach teams on Agile/Scrum best practices
* Risk \& Dependency Management
* Identify cross\-team or cross\-system risks early
* Manage critical path timelines across multiple pods/squads
* Escalate risks to leadership with mitigation plans
* Release \& Delivery Management
* Coordinate release planning, staging, and rollout across teams
* Ensure quality gates (testing, code review, sign\-offs) are met before release
* Own go\-live readiness and post\-release monitoring coordination
* Reporting \& Stakeholder Communication
* Provide status updates, dashboards, and RAID logs to leadership
* Translate technical progress into business\-friendly updates
* Manage stakeholder expectations on timelines and trade\-offs
* Process Improvement
* Continuously refine engineering processes, tooling, and workflows
* Drive operational efficiency across pods


**What Lands You In This Role**
* Experience: 5–8 years of overall experience in software product environments, with a minimum of 3 years operating as a Technical Product Manager, Technical Business Analyst, or Scrum Lead.
* Academic Background: Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering stream. An MBA from a reputable institution is a strong advantage.
* Scrum Mastery: Demonstrated experience successfully running Scrum for cross\-functional engineering teams. Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) credentials are highly preferred.
* Technical Fluency: Strong understanding of system design principles, microservices architectures, REST/GraphQL APIs, cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP), and database infrastructure (SQL/NoSQL).
* Stakeholder Acumen: Proven track record of managing and influencing onsite/onshore stakeholders, resolving cross\-team dependencies, and managing client delivery.
* Tooling Expertise: Advanced hands\-on proficiency with Agile project management tools, specifically JIRA and Confluence.


**What We Offer**
* An opportunity to be part of some of the best enterprise SaaS products to be built out of India.
* Opportunities to quench your thirst for problem\-solving, experimenting, learning, and implementing innovative solutions.
* A flat, collegial work environment, with a work hard, play hard attitude.
* A platform for rapid growth if you are willing to try new things without fear of failure.
* Remuneration with best\-in\-class industry standards with generous health insurance cover


**Some Of Our Accolades Include**
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Companies by Financial Times for five consecutive years: 2020\-2024\.
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies by Inc. 5000 for seven consecutive years: 2018\-2024\.
* Voted \#1 by more than 300 retailers worldwide in the RIS Software LeaderBoard 2024 report.
* Ranked \#72 in America’s Most Innovative Companies list in 2023—by Fortune—alongside companies like Microsoft, Tesla, Apple, IBM, etc.
* Forged a strategic partnership with Google to equip retailers with cutting\-edge generative AI tools.
* Recognized in multiple Gartner reports, including Market Guides and Hype Cycle, spanning assortments, merchandising, forecasting, algorithmic retailing, and Uniﬁed Price, Promotion, and Markdown Optimization Applications.

jobs.title: Data Domain Product Owner
jobs.description:
**CPG Data Domain Product Owner** 




*Domain Consulting — CPG Data \& Analytics Practice* 




 Owns a CPG client's functional data domain (e.g., PLM, MDM, Demand/Supply, O2C) on behalf of the Data \& Analytics consulting practice — translating business process, category, and industry knowledge into the data and product priorities the client actually needs. This is a domain/functional consulting role: the anchor is business process expertise and stakeholder judgment, with enough fluency in data concepts to brief and direct a technical delivery team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Domain \& Process Consulting** 



* Bring deep functional knowledge of the assigned CPG domain (PLM, MDM, Demand/Supply, or O2C) — its business process, industry terminology, and typical pain points — to frame the client's problem correctly before solutioning starts.
* Diagnose gaps between the client's current business process and industry\-standard/best\-practice ways of working; translate these into a prioritized improvement and data agenda.
* Own the product vision and roadmap for the domain, defending it against competing client priorities using business rationale, not just delivery capacity.



**Business Case \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead discovery workshops with client business and IT leadership to surface decision drivers, functional requirements, and desired business outcomes.
* Build and defend the business case for each initiative — value drivers, adoption risk, and change impact — in language a client sponsor (not a technical audience) will act on.
* Federate Global/Local business stakeholders, client IT, and the delivery team into one agreed plan; hold the line on scope and business intent through delivery.



**Requirements \& Adoption** 



* Translate business needs into clear functional requirements (process, rules, decision logic, exceptions) for the delivery team to build against — staying accountable for business intent, not the technical spec itself.
* Define what 'good' looks like for adoption — usability, trust in the output, and change\-readiness — not just technical acceptance criteria.
* Drive adoption through an MVP\-first, test\-and\-learn approach; manage the product/process through its full lifecycle from pilot to scaled rollout.



**Industry \& Practice Contribution** 



* Bring outside\-in perspective — benchmark peer CPG companies and leading practices to keep the client's roadmap current.
* Build reusable domain frameworks, playbooks, and points of view that strengthen the practice's credibility in this functional area.
* Mentor junior consultants on domain knowledge and client stakeholder management; contribute to proposal/pre\-sales narratives in this domain.



**Candidate Profile** 



* 5\+ years in CPG/FMCG business consulting, functional process ownership, or industry practitioner roles (not primarily technical/engineering roles); bachelor's degree required, MBA preferred.
* Deep functional expertise in at least one core CPG domain — PLM (ingredients, formulation, BOM, packaging), MDM/master data governance, Demand/Supply Planning (S\&OP/IBP), or O2C — from either industry or consulting experience.
* Track record leading business process diagnosis and redesign, and building the case for change with senior client stakeholders.
* Comfortable directing (not personally executing) technical/data delivery teams — able to sanity\-check a technical approach against business intent without writing specs or code.
* Strong workshop facilitation, executive communication, and stakeholder management across Global/Local business and IT.
* Familiarity with common enterprise platforms in the domain (e.g., PLM/MDM tools, planning platforms, ERP) at a functional, not configuration, level.



**What Sets You Apart** 



* Thinks and speaks like a domain expert first, technologist second — leads with process and business outcome, not tooling.
* Builds trust with senior client stakeholders fast; earns the right to challenge their thinking on process and priorities.
* Converts ambiguous business pain into a crisp, defensible roadmap without waiting for the technical team to define the problem.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us** 




 Scapia! A credit card that’s out there to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We’re a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don’t stop until we’re proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else! We’ve worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for Group Product Manager to Group Product Manager to lead our Storefront, Recommendations \& CRM
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




 Build the systems that recognize who a user is and serve them something relevant, on the surfaces that matter, through the channels where they are present.
 



  





 This role owns four connected goals:
 



  





 Maximize LTV through personalized discovery and cross\-sell
 



 Build the recommendations platform that powers contextual discovery across homepage, inner pages, order confirmation, and coin pages. The job is to move users through activation, habit formation, retention, and monetization, not just show them more inventory.
 



  





 Deliver a best\-in\-class app and web experience
 



 Reduce performance and reliability friction across the journey: app size, app start time, crash\-free rate, app load time, app\-open\-to\-home latency, and web metrics (FCP, LCP, landing page optimization). This is the foundation the recommendations platform sits on.
 



  





 Build a unified view of customer intent
 



 Combine behavioral and declared signals into a single, coherent picture of what each user wants and when. This powers personalization today and future monetization surfaces including ads, where Scapia's travel\-financial identity graph becomes something advertisers pay to reach.
 



  





 Own communication as a product surface
 



 Build in\-app notifications and CRM systems that optimize for reach and open rate without degrading user trust. Scapia's new and existing cohorts each need a different message, cadence and channel. Getting it right is one of the highest\-leverage, lowest\-cost retention levers available.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 



* The recommendations platform roadmap, surfaces, user signals, context and supply signals that go into the models
* App performance and web performance workstreams, partnering closely with platform and infra engineering
* The customer data and signals strategy that unifies behavioral and declared intent
* CRM and in\-app notification systems, including segmentation logic and trust guardrails



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 7\+ years in product management, with at least 2\-3 years owning a recommendations, personalization, or lifecycle marketing system at meaningful scale
* Demonstrated ability to reason about cohorts, not averages: you segment users by behavior and design differently for each segment rather than shipping one experience for everyone
* Working fluency with app performance metrics (crash\-free rate, cold start time) and web performance metrics (Core Web Vitals), even if you haven't personally owned an infra roadmap
* Experience partnering with data science or ML teams on signal design, feature stores, or recommendation models
* A track record of building CRM or notification systems that grew engagement without eroding trust or triggering fatigue/opt\-outs
* Comfort managing PMs and running a multi\-workstream charter, not just a single feature line
* Financial services, travel, or loyalty/rewards experience is a plus, not a requirement

 Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here's why we stand out:
   

  

* We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190\+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 450\+ employees from 45\+ nationalities


 We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you'll fit right in.
   

  

**The role:**
 Truecaller's ads business reaches over 400 million users and is one of the largest in\-app advertising platforms in its markets. This role owns the supply side of that business: the inventory, placements, ad formats, and user\-facing ad experience where every ad opportunity begins and ends. From the moment an ad opportunity is created on a surface to the moment an ad is rendered, viewed, and clicked, this is your domain.
   

  

 Supply is where revenue meets user experience. You will work with our core product teams to unlock new inventory and evolve existing surfaces, own the quality of every ad interaction, and build the signal foundation that makes our inventory more valuable to every demand source. It is a broad, high\-ownership role for a PM who understands that great ad experiences and great monetization are built together, not traded against each other.
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* **Own the supply roadmap** 
 : inventory strategy, placements, and ad formats across our surfaces and markets, including how the portfolio differs between India and international markets.
* **Unlock new inventory** 
 : partner with core product teams to identify and build new ad placements and rethink existing surfaces without degrading the product experience.
* **Own ad experience quality** 
 : rendering, viewability, latency of display, and click quality, including systematically reducing unintended clicks while growing genuine engagement.
* **Build the signal foundation** 
 : define which user and contextual signals we capture, how users are understood, cohorted, and priced, and how those signals are represented to demand sources to increase inventory value.
* **Own measurement and compliance readiness** 
 : drive certifications such as Open Measurement SDK integration, and ensure our ad surfaces stay ahead of privacy and regulatory requirements in every market we operate in.
* **Serve the demand side** 
 : act as the supply counterpart to our programmatic and direct demand teams, turning their signal and inventory needs into shipped capabilities.


**What you bring in:**
* **Experience** 
 : 4\+ years in product management, with meaningful time building ad products or monetization surfaces at a consumer platform or publisher with a large advertising business.
* **Ad experience craft (must\-have)** 
 : deep understanding of ad formats, placements, and rendering, and a track record of improving monetization outcomes (CTR, viewability, fill) while protecting user experience and click quality.
* **Publisher\-side fluency** 
 : understanding of how inventory is packaged, priced, and represented to demand sources, and experience working with multiple demand channels (direct, programmatic, or mediated).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Metaforms is an Agentic OS for Market Research, using AI agents to make research delivery faster and easier across the entire project lifecycle. The platform supports tasks such as questionnaire drafting, survey programming, data validation, cleaning and coding open ends, and preparing tables and reports within a unified workflow.
 



  





 Teams can adopt Metaforms without changing their existing platforms or processes, with support for major survey tools including Decipher, Confirmit, Qualtrics, and Dimensions. Metaforms enables research professionals to leverage AI for heavy\-lift operational work while retaining full human judgment and quality control, continually improving performance through feedback, rules, and templates.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 The Senior Product Manager will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Metaforms’ Agentic OS, shaping how market research teams integrate AI into their delivery operations. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in Bengaluru and involves close collaboration with engineering, design, data science, and customer\-facing teams to prioritize features, refine workflows, and ensure product\-market fit.
 



  





 Day\-to\-day responsibilities include gathering and synthesizing user insights, converting them into clear product requirements, managing backlogs, running discovery and validation experiments, and tracking product performance against defined metrics. The Senior Product Manager will also coordinate launches, support go\-to\-market efforts, and iterate on the product based on customer feedback and usage data, ensuring the platform remains dependable for production\-scale research work.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Product management skills: experience owning product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle, translating user needs into requirements, and working with cross\-functional teams.
* Market research and analytics skills: familiarity with survey programming platforms (e.g., Decipher, Confirmit, Qualtrics, Dimensions), research workflows, and delivery operations. If you do not have familiarity, willingness to learn, adapt and quickly emulate the user journey of end\-users is critical to success in this role.
* Technical and AI\-related skills: ability to work closely with product engineers, applied AI engineers, Subject Matter Experts. Ability to understand AI\-driven workflows, and define requirements for agent\-based features.
* User\-centered design and discovery skills: proficiency in user research, problem framing, hypothesis\-driven experimentation, and validating solutions with stakeholders.
* Business and communication skills: strong stakeholder management, clear written and verbal communication, and data\-informed decision\-making.
* Leadership and collaboration: experience mentoring product team members, driving alignment across functions, and influencing outcomes without formal authority.
* Relevant experience: several years in product management for B2B SaaS or workflow tools; experience in market research or analytics platforms is highly beneficial.
* Education and work style: bachelor’s or higher degree in a relevant field (e.g., engineering, business, statistics, social sciences) and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, on\-site team environment in Bengaluru.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Introduction
   

  

**Job Title:**
 Revenue Operations Manager
   

  

**Location:**
 India (Remote/Hybrid; minimum of 3 hours overlap with US time zones required)
   

  

**Reports To:**
 Director of Revenue
   

  

**Overview:**
 SymphonyAI is seeking a Revenue Operations Manager based in India to lead and optimize our quote\-to\-cash processes across Sales, Legal, Finance, and IT. You will own the systems, data, and workflows that power bookings and revenue, ensuring operational excellence, policy compliance, and clean handoffs from CRM/CPQ to ERP. This role partners closely with the Revenue Accounting team to ensure Sales Orders and contract changes are accurate and complete before booking, and requires hands\-on leadership across Salesforce, CPQ, CLM, and NetSuite (ERP/SuiteBilling).
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Quote\-to\-Cash Ownership:**
* Design, document, and continuously improve end\-to\-end processes from lead to order to cash, aligning with company bookings and revenue policies
* Operate Deal Desk to support complex quotes, discounting, non\-standard terms, and approvals; ensure required fields and evidence are captured for downstream revenue recognition


**Systems and Data:**
* Govern CRM\-to\-ERP data flow and ensure accurate and complete Sales Order creation in NetSuite
* Maintain data quality and governance (field definitions, mandatory fields, SLAs, duplicates, enrichment) for reliable reporting and clean revenue outcomes
* Define and maintain mapping between CPQ products and NetSuite items, subsidiaries, currencies, tax codes, and billing schedules; leverage NetSuite saved searches/reports to monitor Sales Order accuracy and error rates


**Sales Order and Contract Hygiene:**
* Establish booking gates and pre\-booking checks (term dates, billing schedules, items/SKUs, pricing/discounts, delivery/acceptance indicators, PO/TCs) to ensure Sales Orders are complete/accurate before handoff to Finance and NetSuite creation
* Run renewal and amendment workflows for upsells, downsells, and term changes in CRM/CPQ/CLM; coordinate with Revenue Accounting to ensure contract modifications are correctly reflected in NetSuite


**Controls, Compliance \& Change Management:**
* Design and operate key operational controls across quote\-to\-cash (approvals, data validations, booking gates)
* Maintain change control and UAT documentation for system releases in Salesforce and NetSuite
* Partner with Legal on standard terms and with Finance on booking policy alignment; provide audit support and evidence as needed


**Continuous Improvement:**
* Identify and deliver automation and tooling enhancements across Salesforce, CPQ, CLM, and NetSuite
* Lead cross\-functional projects to reduce cycle times and improve data quality


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related field; MBA or advanced certification is a plus
* 5\+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or related GTM operations roles within a SaaS environment
* Hands\-on NetSuite (ERP) experience required; familiarity with ARM and revenue implications of order data is a plus
* Proven experience with CRM\-to\-ERP integrations and data governance; demonstrated ability to ensure accurate Sales Order creation and updates in NetSuite
* Demonstrated Deal Desk experience supporting complex quotes, discounting controls, and non\-standard terms/approvals
* Advanced Excel and proficiency with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker); SQL or similar analytics skills a plus
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; ability to translate business requirements into scalable processes and system configurations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to diagnose data/process issues and drive root\-cause fixes
* High attention to detail and strong organizational skills; ability to manage multiple projects in a dynamic, global environment
* Legally authorized to work in India; able to support a minimum of 3 hours overlap with US time zones


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Familiarity with ARM, revenue recognition, and revenue implications of order data
* Experience with automation and process improvement initiatives in revenue operations


**Diversity \& Inclusion Statement:**
 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.
