* Prior experience in scientific, industrial, or instrument\-control software environments is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as FDA or ISO standards / ISTQB certification

**Overview**  

As a Principal Engineering Manager on the **Azure Native Integrations team**, you will lead a team responsible for foundational platform and services that make it effortless for customers to discover, provision, and operate best\-in\-class partner (ISV) offerings natively within Azure/ Foundry. These Integrations focuses on delivering a first\-class, unified experience—spanning identity, billing, provisioning, and management—so partner services feel like a natural extension of the Microsoft platform across the portal, SDKs, and APIs, operating at significant scale and complexity. We work with large Enterprise technology provider ISVS across multiple categories: Observability, Data and Storage, Networks, Security, AI. Our work spans partner integration platforms, provisioning and control\-plane services, and the paved paths that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining reliability and security.

**We provide tooling, services, and operational support that allow partners and customers to onboard and run integrated services safely and efficiently. In this role you will set up the technical vision and own the end\-to\-end strategy for two critical charters: Azure Native Partner integration experience, and an AI\-based, agentic solution that automates and orchestrates onboarding and maintainability.** The team plays a critical role in maintaining trust in Azure's partner ecosystem while balancing speed, scale, security, and stability.


Azure's continued growth brings both opportunity and complexity. As a Principal Engineering Manager in this role, you will lead a team operating mission\-critical systems in a fast\-moving environment. You'll work closely with engineers and partners across the company to reduce onboarding friction, improve service reliability, respond to incidents, and evolve our AI\-driven platforms to meet the needs of a rapidly scaling partner ecosystem. This role blends people\-leadership, technical depth, and operational ownership, with a direct impact on the daily experience of Azure customers and partners worldwide.

 **Responsibilities**  

Your typical week would include:

* Collaborating with engineering teams, product management, partners, and engineering leadership to align on and understand the problems we want to solve across our ISV partners and build strategy, lead adoption for agentic solution.
* Unblocking obstacles for your team members as they solve Azure Native Integrations' most critical problems, often via real\-time conversations in Teams and Slack and with asynchronous communication in GitHub Issues, PRs, Discussions, and Projects
* Communicating effectively to stakeholders and leadership of progress and risks
* Coordinating work within the team and stakeholders, building relationships, and identifying opportunities and areas of improvement
* Ensuring the team produces good architectural design outcomes, secure and resilient systems, and quality code—including a high bar for agentic safety, evaluation, and reliability across services
* Ensuring the team iteratively ships features and bug fixes, balancing speed to market with future velocity
* Conducting 1:1s with direct reports to provide regular feedback and ensure career growth and progression
 **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:**

* 10\+ years' experience in software engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline.

**Job Title:Digital Product Manager**

* Own and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for DIVA (Digital Identity Verification \& Authentication), ensuring secure, compliant, and seamless identity verification experiences across customer journeys and markets. You’ll align business, technology, operations, and risk stakeholders to deliver measurable outcomes (conversion, pass rates, resilience, fraud reduction) while meeting regulatory and control expectations.

**In this role, you will:**

**Product strategy \& roadmap**

* Define and maintain the multi\-year DIVA product vision and roadmap aligned to business outcomes and market needs (e.g., account onboarding, mobile setup, servicing, step\-up verification).
* Lead ideation with cross\-functional stakeholders to shape opportunities into prioritized initiatives, and translate them into clear business cases (problem statement, options, costs, benefits, risks, and success metrics)
* Translate business cases into prioritized capabilities/epics/features with clear value cases, success metrics, and delivery milestones.
* Identify opportunities to scale DIVA across markets and business lines; drive standardization aimed to improve speed and control.

**Customer journey \& experience**

* Optimize end\-to\-end verification journeys to improve completion and pass rates while minimizing friction.
* Use data (funnel analytics, error codes, VOC) to diagnose drop\-offs and drive iterative improvements (e.g., retries, step\-up flows, guided capture).
* Partner with design and engineering to deliver accessible, inclusive experiences across devices and markets.

**Delivery leadership**

* Lead cross\-functional squads (engineering, UX, data, QA) to deliver outcomes using agile practices.
* Own product requirements (PRDs/user stories), acceptance criteria, and release readiness.
* Manage dependencies across platforms (mobile/web), downstream consuming journeys etc

**Risk, controls, and governance**

* Ensure DIVA capabilities meet security, privacy, and regulatory requirements; partner closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Model Risk as applicable.
* Embed controls\-by\-design (auditability, monitoring, exception handling, operational playbooks).
* Support governance forums with clear reporting on DIVA performance, incidents, and remediation plans.

**Vendor \& commercial management** (where applicable)

* Manage vendor capabilities and performance (SLA, pass rates, latency, incident response) and support vendor selection/renewals assessments.
* Drive resilience and continuity plans (e.g., multi\-vendor strategy, failover, benchmarking/shadow mode).
* Partner with markets and consuming journey owners on commercials, forecasting, and benefits tracking.

**Data \& performance management**

* Define KPIs and instrumentation standards; ensure dashboards exist for markets/journeys (pass rate, completion, latency, fallout, fraud outcomes).
* Run experiments (A/B tests, shadow mode evaluations) and convert insights into roadmap decisions.
* Own benefits realization and post\-launch performance reviews.

**Stakeholder leadership**

* Act as the primary product point of contact for DIVA across business lines and markets.
* Facilitate alignment on priorities, funding, and sequencing; communicate trade\-offs clearly.
* Coach and mentor junior product managers/analysts where relevant.

**Key deliverables**

* DIVA product strategy, quarterly/annual roadmap, and prioritized backlog
* Product requirements and customer journey designs for new capabilities
* KPI framework and performance dashboards

**Governance packs** (risk/control evidence, vendor performance, incident learnings)

* Business cases for major initiatives (investment, benefits, dependencies)

**To be successful you will:**

**Essential**

* Experience as a Digital Product Manager/Owner delivering customer\-facing products at scale.
* Strong understanding of digital identity verification, authentication, or fraud/risk controls in financial services (or similarly regulated industries).
* Proven ability to use data to drive product decisions (funnels, conversion, operational metrics).
* Experience leading cross\-functional delivery teams and managing complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Strong written communication: ability to produce crisp product requirement materials, decision papers, and governance updates.

**Desirable**

* Experience with IDV vendors and concepts such as liveness, face match, document verification, and FAR/FRRs handling.
* Knowledge of resilience patterns (multi\-vendor, failover, circuit breakers) and observability.
* Familiarity with privacy/security\-by\-design and model governance concepts (where ML is involved).
* Experience operating products across multiple markets with localization and regulatory variation.

**Working relationships**

* Technology engineering leads, architecture, test leads
* UX/design and journey product teams (consumers of DIVA)
* Fraud Risk, Financial Crime, Data Risk \& Controls, Compliance
* Vendors

 We're looking for a Product Owner who will help transform ideas into innovative solutions, ensuring COSMOS continues to empower our teams, streamline processes, and support the next stage of TLC's growth.

 Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting\-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
   

  

 Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.

**About Us**
 We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
   

  

 Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
   

  

**Overview**
 The Product Manager owns the entire product lifecycle, from conceptualization to obsolescence, defining what to build by translating market and customer needs into solutions that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. This role is responsible for developing product roadmaps, managing product P\&L, and ensuring alignment with customer needs and market opportunities. The Product Manager partners cross\-functionally to deliver and maintain innovative, high\-impact products that meet business objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute 5\-year product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle from development to obsolescence
* Set product priorities for new developments and manage product P\&L to optimize margins
* Create comprehensive business cases outlining expected returns
* Define product positioning and ensure designs meet customer use cases
* Owns and accurately maintains product information throughout the lifecycle
* Gather and analyze Voice of Customer insights to inform product features and functionality
* Translate market and customer insights into clear product requirements, features, and technical direction
* Balance growth, cost, and profitability through disciplined product portfolio and lifecycle management
* Own product data integrity and structure, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with global data standards to enable effective commercialization, analytics, and digital tools
* Support pricing strategy and execution by providing product inputs (e.g., cost, features, value drivers) and partnering with Pricing to enable value\-based pricing, margin optimization, and competitive positioning
* Develop and support sales enablement tools (e.g., product documentation, technical collateral, value drivers) to ensure accurate representation of product capabilities and effective customer engagement
* Partner cross\-functionally (engineering, operations, commercial) to ensure successful delivery and adoption
* Continuously refine products based on performance, feedback, and evolving customer needs


**KPIs**
* Revenue and profitability by product line
* Market share growth vs. competitors
* ROI on new product development
* Roadmap execution (on\-time, in\-scope delivery)
* Customer satisfaction and product adoption


**Required Qualifications**
* Minimum five years of experience in product management, product development, or a related field.
* Proven leadership and communication skills with success in aligning cross\-functional teams to deliver product roadmaps and achieve revenue goals.
* Advanced proficiency with product lifecycle management tools, data analysis platforms, and performance tracking systems.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills rooted in data\-driven decision\-making and customer\-centric product development.
* A relentless pursuit of excellence and a strong desire to build innovative products that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation.
* Deep commitment to ownership, continuous learning, and taking proactive steps to improve product outcomes.


**Preferred Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, marketing, or a related field.
* Advanced knowledge of product positioning, pricing strategies, and P\&L management.
* Experience in developing business cases, ROI analysis, and product roadmaps.
* Deep understanding of Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, translating into product requirements.
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools.


**Our Commitment to Our People**

Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. As the PM for CareOps, you'll drive a high\-impact roadmap: improving workload distribution across the care team through algorithmic engine enhancements, migrating complex operational workflows into a modern internal platform, automating member offboarding, and supporting the rollout of new care programs. You'll partner closely with Demand Enablement, Member Ops, Clinical Operations, and a Bangalore\-based engineering team, with significant collaboration with US\-based stakeholders. This role sits within the CareHub neighborhood and reports to the Director of Product for CareHub.

* Design the strategy to overhaul our internal tool for workforce management. This includes RBAC, audit logging, and key features like dashboards, dynamic coverage management and more
* Ship improvements to our care team to member assignment engine that improve our care team member workloads.
* Reduce operational average handle time for key workflows
* Define MVPs, set KPIs, and build out a multi quarter roadmap for the CareOps pod with clearly defined success metrics and delivery milestones
* Write high\-quality PRDs and partner with engineering to drive features from discovery to launch with minimal rework

* Experience with algorithmic systems such as matching, scheduling, routing, or capacity management

* Comfortable working with data teams; able to interpret analytical outputs and use them to inform roadmap decisions and measure impact

**Hinge Health Hybrid Model**
 We believe that remote work and in\-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.
   

  

 This is a Bengaluru\-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.
 **Time zones:** 
 San Francisco is the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time – for example, 8AM in San Francisco is 8:30 PM in Bengaluru. Standard working hours in San Francisco are between 8AM – 6PM. For this role, applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time.

 At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1\.7 billion people worldwide. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post\-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence\-based care.
   

  

 As the preferred partner to 50\+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com/

* Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).
* Well\-being support: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well\-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.
* Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.


**Culture \& Engagement**
 Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.
   

  

 By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy.

We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. jobs.description:
**POSITION TITLE: Data Mapping Analyst, Servicing Transaction Management**

**Position Summary:**

The Servicing Transaction Management department is responsible for the loan boarding and deboarding process. This role relates to converting other servicers data to upload into Onity’s loan servicing system and subsequently validating the data uploaded versus the data and/or documents received for all newly boarded loans. This position is responsible for developing projects in the loan boarding and related applications for bulk and flow transfers. The Data Mapping Analyst will analyze and program boarding files, as well as participate in data mapping, researching issues and testing the application and data loads. This position requires strong analytical skills and technical knowledge to support the Loansphere Loan Boarding System (LLB) as well as the Onity proprietary Loan Boarding Tool. The Data Analyst will work closely with various parties including their immediate team, business units, prior servicers and other technical teams to coordinate data transformation. This role will also be responsible for implementing tools to support transfer efficiency, as well as keeping documentation updated and communicating changes to processes, procedures and tools.


**JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:*** Ensures that new loan programs or changes are incorporated into the boarding process.
* Analyzes boarding error messages to determine root cause and remediates issues.
* Creates edit checks within the Loan Baording System to recognize errors prior to boarding.
* Develop and configure the Loan Boarding System, as well as supporting toolsets such as SharePoint to support boarding data management. This includes mapping of seller/prior servicer data, create and update tables and define and implement solutions for converting the data.
* Perform testing to support trials and production. Review error reports and document/communicate issues found. Determine solutions for issues.
* Define requirements for and implement tools and processes to improve data quality and visibility.
* Work closely via meetings and conference calls with Business Unit Leads and prior servicers to ensure data transformation is accurate and clearly communicated.
* Update/create procedures and continue to enhance and optimize the boarding process, including tool enhancements as required.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements (i.e. RESPA, USAP, Sarbox, etc.).
* Produce and review required control reporting.
* Meet all established milestones for deboarding/boarding project plans.
* Follow all established procedures regarding boarding/deboarding.
* Ensure all quality steps are completed and documented.
* Escalate any possible deadline misses.
* Communicate boarding/deboarding expectations with internal and external clients regularly.
* Organize meetings with internal and external clients with documented meeting minutes.
* Self\-driven, should be able to handle high pressure.
* Must identify ways to automate processes and set up controls when required.
* Willing to work extra hours as per the process requirements/Flexibility to work in accordance with Business requirements.

**KEY RESULTS AREA:*** Reduce number of Servicing Transaction Management related customer complaints by a designated management percentage year over year.
* Maintain quality at 100%.
* Meet all milestones related to the loan boarding process.
* Timely responses to servicers and internal parties.

**QUALIFICATIONS:*** This position requires a significant amount of mortgage servicing knowledge, including but not limited to, the ability to identify and understand various data points utilized within loan servicing systems to successfully service loans and interpret mortgage loan collateral and loan servicing documentation used in conjunction with the data to service loans.
* Experience with different loan programs such as ARM’s, HELOC’s, buydowns, Commercial, etc.
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred, or minimum of five (5\) \+ years’ mortgage servicing experience.
* SQL experience preferred
* Minimum of 4 years’ experience working with LoanSphere Loan Boarding (LLB).
* MSP servicing system experience required.
* Advanced PC skills: Microsoft applications, including Excel and Access Database, Monarch, Adobe, SharePoint and LoanSphere Loan Boarding (LLB).
* Ability to deal with complex difficult problems involving multiple facets and variables in non\-standardized situations.
* Ability to set up controls and being able to speak to auditors/QA teams regarding process
* Ability to identify inconsistencies or issues in data and help come up with solutions
* Set up organized structure for incoming mapping changes and tracking for all internal and external partners.
* Ability to work independently, meet established deadlines, be very detail orientated, and have excellent organizational skills.
* Organizational skillset able to handle multiple transactions at the same time
* Ability to easily adapt to changes in processes, procedures and priorities.
* Proven strength in interpreting business requirements and implementing them in application or operational tools.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external clients to determine requirements
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with Empower or Encompass origination system a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills and attention to detail and accuracy.

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Lead Data Analyst:**  

  

**Own the business problem, not the ticket.**  

Our games are played by millions of people daily. Every session leaves a trail: a level attempted eleven times, a bundle ignored, a player who quietly stopped opening the app on a Tuesday. Billions of these events land in our warehouse each month — and some of them are the difference between a game that grows and one that doesn't.  

We're looking for a Lead Data Analyst who wants to be handed a problem rather than a query request. You'll decide what's worth investigating, build the models and pipelines to investigate it, and defend the decision in front of leadership.  

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Go deep, not wide.** Run in\-depth analyses that end in a decision: funnel drop\-offs, cohort behaviour, segment deep\-dives, feature post\-mortems. Own the "why," not just the dashboard.
* **Own the churn numbers.** Know retention and churn cold — by cohort, level, segment, geo. Build churn prediction that fires early enough for an intervention to exist, then prove the intervention moved the metric.
* **Predict player value.** LTV and revenue forecasting the business can plan against — robust to seasonality, cohort mix, and content cadence.
* **Tune the economy.** Sources and sinks, currency inflation, reward\-event faucets, bundle pricing and elasticity. Catch drift before players do.
* **Understand paying and non\-paying players.** What separates them behaviourally, where the conversion moment actually sits, and what it means for pricing and content.
* **Run experimentation properly.** Design and analyze A/B tests: sizing and power up front, guardrail metrics, and the integrity to call a flat result flat.
* **Own the data.** Architect and optimise pipelines connecting game telemetry, the warehouse, and ML systems. Data quality, definitions and cost are yours, not just the final chart.
* **Make leadership fluent.** Turn analysis into narrative for Product and Engineering leadership — and hold up under challenge.
* **Build self\-serve and mentor.** Dashboards (Metabase/Looker/Tableau) that answer the recurring questions, and a team of analysts you're actively raising the bar for.

 **What We're Looking Fo**r

* **6–9 years** in data analytics, ideally gaming, consumer tech, or mobile apps.
* **Mastery of SQL — non\-negotiable.** This is the core of the job. Window functions, complex joins across billions of rows, query optimisation, and the discipline to write SQL someone else can read six months later. Most of your answers will start here.
* **Strong Python** for analysis and automation — pandas/numpy, scripting, and pipeline work.
* **Judgment about Gen AI.** You use LLMs where they earn their place — boilerplate SQL, code review, drafting, summarising qualitative data, exploratory scaffolding — and you don't where they don't: numbers you'll present, causal claims, anything you can't verify. You know the difference between a fast answer and a correct one, and you check.
* **Big data and pipelines:** Redshift, Athena, BigQuery, Hive or Spark, plus orchestration
* **Real statistical foundations:** experiment design, causal inference basics, quantitative modelling you can explain to a skeptic.
* **Ownership:** projects driven end\-to\-end, and people made better along the way.
* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in CS, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or similar.
* **Visualisation:** Looker, Tableau, Metabase or Power BI.

 **Bonus Points:**

* Mobile gaming analytics — retention curves, in\-game economy, monetisation, LiveOps.
* Experience standing up an experimentation platform or feature store.
* Anything you've shipped that changed a game design decision.  

  

***If you've ever been frustrated that your best analysis ended in a slide instead of a shipped change — this is the other kind of job.***

With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost\-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise .

As our primary in\-house client advocate, the Business Analyst works closely with the stakeholders, technical team, and SMEs to lead and facilitate discussions to understand the client's needs, ask clarifying questions, discuss alternative scenarios, and turn them into requirements. Once the requirements are captured, the Business Analyst will work closely with our technical team (product owners, project manager, development manager, and technical lead) to help design and develop a solution to meet the client's requirements. Throughout the project's life, the Business Analyst's primary responsibility is representing the client and ensuring all deliverables align with the project's vision. This involves working with virtually every member of the project team, both internal and client\-facing, to facilitate communication, review the quality of deliverables, and ensure project success.

More importantly, one must have an interest in problem\-solving, a positive attitude, and a willingness to learn. Ultimately, working as a Business Analyst, you will learn to quickly break down and understand varying business processes, help to identify gaps or areas for improvement in those processes, and then work with our Senior Business Analyst or Application Owner to translate those into requirements via visual and written documentation. Because our clients span a wide range of internal organizational styles, no two projects are the same, and business Analyst bridge the gap between operational and technical resources. Our Business Analysts should be able to follow our standard project processes and adjust those processes on the fly to meet the needs of the client or project.

* Assess, research, analyze and document sponsor/stakeholder/request needs.
* Identify and diagnose business problems and potential solutions.
